measure_before.existing_weight_perturbation_envelope: none recorded; baseline values and registered weights are frozen in the source candidate artifacts/manifests

method.baseline_weights: equal weights over active stored component channels; A2/A3 masks are all subsets consistent with their registered equal-mean composite rule, with worst-case absolute effects used when ambiguous; A1 retains all three finite channels and applies only the reweighting delta to its frozen Sca5/region-anchor composite
method.change: perturbed component mixture minus baseline component mixture, added to frozen coverage_gap_score only as a sensitivity delta; this does not replace or rebuild a candidate; ambiguous equal-mean masks use the maximum absolute possible change
method.decision_rule: flag a region unstable when any candidate/component/sign scenario has p95 absolute change > 0.02; report only, do not select or alter weights
method.perturbation: one component weight is multiplied by 1 +/- 0.10; other active weights are held at their baseline values; all active weights are then renormalized to sum to one

A2_spectral.registered_composite_rule: equal mean over defined R, B, and POI estimates

A3_dawid_skene.registered_composite_rule: equal mean over defined R, B, and POI estimates
